name: WEC Predictions
summary: Multi-class endurance forecasts for the FIA World Endurance Championship.
description: Scaffolded on the shared MotorsportVerse core with working seams: a snapshot-backed DataSource implementing the core calendar/grid/results contract, a leakage-guarded prior-form Predictor, and a contract test suite asserting that nothing is fabricated while no feed is wired. The open design questions that must be settled before ingestion — the car-not-driver scoring unit, per-class ordering, and 6h-vs-24h retirement risk — are documented in the project README.
